media.title: Cops for a first grader?: Why NYC schools are still calling 911 on 6-year-olds
media.note: A six-year-old recently diagnosed with autism had the police and an ambulance sent to his Brooklyn school after a meltdown. New York City schools still call 911 on students in crisis more than 2,000 times a year.
